assumptions.economics: Six retained months, .60 incremental margin, assumed contact costs .25/1/2/5, fixed startup 5000, USD-equivalent units; not verified operating facts.
assumptions.frozen_roi: 100000 hypothetical-customer frozen nominal 10% threshold: net(gamma)=G*gamma-K; G and K are quoted aggregates via stored_constants, not recomputed from test rows. K quotes the frozen $1/contact plus fixed startup assumption.
assumptions.gamma: Beta(6,14), Beta(6,24), Beta(2,18) prevention-rate priors are assumptions; uniform independent prevention across selected would-be churners is assumed, not inferred from churn risk or value. No treatment labels exist; response heterogeneity is not estimated.
assumptions.horizon12: 12 identical future cohorts under the same gamma/economics; EVPI x12 is conditional arithmetic, not a discounted cash forecast.
assumptions.population: 75000 non-test train+validation observations class-weighted to 100000 hypothetical customers at 2% prior; label shift and within-class representativeness are unverified.
assumptions.value: Frozen capped recurring-charge proxy, not observed incremental contribution or treatment responsiveness.

audit_reproduction.cutoff: Stable descending score; left searchsorted at fraction*sum(w); include all score >= cutoff ties.
audit_reproduction.new_curve_rule: Eligible for conditional non-test curves; no promotion.
audit_reproduction.prohibition: Stored frozen_threshold and in-sample p_s are not used for OOF budget replay.

band.interpretation: Sensitivity across three assumed priors, not a confidence/credible interval.
band.statement: P(net>0) between 17% and 93% depending on the prevention-rate prior; central 69% (Beta(6,24)); computed probabilities 0.168233/0.930004/0.685037.

deviations: [E] Preregistered randomized stratified inverse-CDF Monte Carlo replaces iid draws to reduce quantile uncertainty; one million draws/prior are non-iid and no iid MCSE is reported.
[E] PNG deliberately shows only the three $1 curves; its title discloses that all twelve cost/prior curves remain in the full SHA-bound CSV (when reproduction succeeds).
[E] Added a $0 no-campaign audit and $0.000001 absolute replay-net check at the stored fraction; no new budget selection criterion is tuned.

method.monte_carlo: N=1000000 per prior, (arange(N)+rng(3).random(N))/N then beta.ppf; single sequential seeded generator, fixed prior order; non-iid randomized stratification. Linear empirical 5th percentile. No adaptive draws, tuning, clipping, or iid MCSE.
method.quadrature: scipy.integrate.quad eplus on [g_star,1], abs difference strictly below 1e-9.
method.references: User-supplied approximate brief values, retained as references, never substituted for computed estimates.
